blocks.text: Planning a wedding can take months. This October, Cebuano couples can tackle much of that work in one weekend as Radisson Blu Cebu’s Something Blu returns for its 10th edition, bringing 114 wedding exhibitors under one roof. Something Blu: A Decade of Love Stories will run on October 10 and 11 at the Santa Maria Grand Ballroom of Radisson Blu Cebu, bringing together wedding planners, stylists, photographers, caterers, designers, and other suppliers involved in putting a celebration together. The bridal fair traces its roots to a pre-launch in 2013. It paused from 2020 to 2022 during the pandemic before returning in […]...
